items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: So, through a mutual friend she came to my house to play the tape and we were engaged and married immediately.

ctx.x: That's when Bud Powell sent Anita a birthday tape and she didn't have a tape player. So, through a mutual friend she came to my house to play the tape and we were engaged and married immediately. (Imagine that?)?
And I met Bud in Paris, right?
